GENERAL SAFETY PRECAUTIONS OF CLARK SAFARI ZOOFollow Signs: Adhere to zoo guidelines and signage.
Stay on Paths: Stick to designated areas.
Don't Feed Animals: Avoid feeding or disturbing them.
Keep Distance: Stay a safe distance from enclosures.
Supervise Kids: Keep children under close watch.
Practice Hygiene: Wash hands after touching animals/exhibits.
Dress Appropriately: Wear comfortable clothing and shoes.
Report Issues: Alert staff to any problems or distressed animals.

What conservation efforts is the zoo involved in?Clark Safari is committed to wildlife conservation by supporting breeding
programs, educating the public about biodiversity, and collaborating with
organizations that protect endangered species.
Are there educational talks or guided tours?Currently no guided tours since our zoo is self guided but we have directory
and sinages, trivia's allocate in every area for guest information.
How does the zoo ensure the animals' welfare?Clark Safari ensures the animals' welfare through proper nutrition, regular
health checks by our veterinary team, and enriching habitats that mimic their
natural environments.
Do you have information about the animals' natural habitats?Yes, information about the animals' natural habitats is displayed at their
enclosures. You can also ask our animal keeper assigned per area for
additional details.
Is there a lost and found area?We do not have lost and found section. But If you lose an item, please
approach our staff or visit the window 1, ticketing booth.
Can I bring a drone or other equipment for photography?For safety and privacy reasons, drones are not allowed inside Clark Safari.
Other photography equipment is permitted, but please avoid using flash as it
may disturb the animals.
